baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural sons are qualified by a form of ش ه د, so filiation is joined to active presence rather than stated by itself.
baseline_models.mechanism: Kin belonging supplies a household group, while presence-with-witnessing places that group within the subject's immediate social field.

activation_trace.role: Filiation and derived belonging supplies the sons as a kin group rather than an undifferentiated plurality.
Presence with witnessing makes the sons immediately available within the subject's social space.

changed_reading.before: The clause only says that the subject has sons.
changed_reading.after: The clause presents a resident filial entourage whose value lies partly in being continuously at hand.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شُهُودًا can activate knowledgeable attestation as well as physical attendance, while بَنِينَ fixes the witnesses inside the kin group.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sons can function not only as companions but as people whose knowledge and speech publicly validate the household's claims and standing.

activation_trace.role: Filiation supplies a loyal relation from which an attesting entourage can be formed.
Testifying from knowledge gives the sons a possible evidentiary and reputational function.

changed_reading.before: The adjective only locates the sons nearby.
changed_reading.after: Their nearness can also make them an attesting circle that lends public force to the father's position.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus combines the ب ن ي support image with the ش ه د sign image in the concrete phrase 'sons witnessing/present.'
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch-distant architectural image treats the sons as settled supports, and their visibility makes that support structure a sign of household stability.

activation_trace.role: Ribs and house-posts supply a structural-support image for the plural sons.
A witnessing sign makes the support publicly legible rather than merely private.

changed_reading.before: The sons are a familial fact.
changed_reading.after: The sons can be pictured as the visible human framework that holds up a household's settled standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation in an isolated state followed by present plural offspring turns filial attendance into a bestowed reversal of original aloneness, exposing dependence beneath apparent self-sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: Filiation supplies the plural kin relation that now contrasts with solitary origin.
Immediate presence makes the contrast with aloneness spatially and socially concrete.
The act of bringing creation into being supplies the prior condition from which the later household was granted.
Separation and aloneness supplies the singular pole reversed by the present sons.

structural_cues: The focus follows the singular creation statement after only one intervening provision clause.
The singular condition in 74:11 is answered by the plural kin group in 74:13.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created aloneness and later present sons; I infer a before-to-after reversal that marks the sons as bestowed dependence. Alternatively, 'alone' may qualify only the act of creation rather than a prolonged social condition.

changed_reading.before: Present sons display an independently established patriarch's strength.
changed_reading.after: Their presence records how a once-solitary creature was furnished with kin, so the display of strength simultaneously witnesses dependence on the giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extended wealth, settled human supports, and comprehensive preparation form one provisioned apparatus; the sons are the resident personnel of an already smoothed estate.

activation_trace.role: House-posts and ribs supply the image of sons as stabilizing supports within a larger provisioned structure.
Presence makes those supports resident and operational rather than remote.
Accumulated wealth supplies the material base surrounding the filial support.
Connected increase that extends another thing turns the wealth into sustained material capacity.
Preparation and leveling supplies the enabling environment in which wealth and present sons function together.

structural_cues: 74:12-14 coordinate wealth, sons, and emphatic preparation as consecutive first-person provisions.
The focus is the human middle term between extended material capacity and a thoroughly prepared environment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth, extension, structural support, presence, and preparation; I infer functional coordination into a household apparatus. A live alternative is that the sequence merely enumerates independent favors.

changed_reading.before: The sons are chiefly an affective or genealogical blessing.
changed_reading.after: The sons are also resident human infrastructure, stabilizing and operating the extended, prepared field of privilege.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate turn from already-present plural sons to appetite for further increase converts kin from a completed relation into one increment within an open-ended acquisition logic.

activation_trace.role: Plural filiation supplies real persons whose relational value is vulnerable to being treated as accumulated quantity.
Their present availability makes the existing increment tangible before the demand for more.
The heart's appetite supplies the acquisitive pressure applied to the preceding gifts.
Growth and addition supplies the unclosed ledger into which even the present sons can be counted.

structural_cues: The additive sequence of 74:12-14 is followed immediately by desire for further addition in 74:15.
The sons appear grammatically as one coordinated provision within that sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural sons followed by appetite for increase; I infer that the subject mentally assimilates kin to an accumulation ledger. The desired increase could instead concern an unspecified favor and leave the sons relationally untouched.

changed_reading.before: The sons complete a picture of familial abundance.
changed_reading.after: They expose abundance's failure to satisfy: even present children become an already-booked increment from which desire immediately moves onward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The witnessing-sign branch of ش ه د meets visible signs and resistance to truth, reversing the sons from witnesses for the man's status into visible evidence against his response.

activation_trace.role: Filiation keeps the proposed evidence concrete: the favor consists of actual kin belonging.
The witnessing-sign image lets the sons' visible presence register as evidence rather than only prestige.
A manifest sign supplies the evidentiary category into which visible filial abundance can be read.
Deviation from straightness and resistance to truth supplies the hostile response that turns favor into counterwitness.

structural_cues: The refusal in 74:16 follows directly after the wealth-sons-preparation sequence and the demand for more.
The focus adjective itself carries both visible-presence and evidentiary potential.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible filial presence, a manifest-sign branch, and resistance to signs; I infer that the sons can count as one visible sign of prior favor. They may instead remain only an adjacent gift, not one of the referenced signs.

changed_reading.before: The sons' visibility attests to the father's standing for his benefit.
changed_reading.after: The same visibility can attest against him: the attended household is evidence of favor placed immediately beside resistance to signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal selfhood, personal acquisition, and collateralized liability disaggregate the household entourage: each person is held by personal earning, so filial presence cannot transfer or pool accountability.

activation_trace.role: Filiation supplies the strongest natural bond that the later liability rule must nevertheless separate.
Physical presence supplies proximity without the power to merge one person's liability with another's.
The thing's own self and identity supplies the irreducible unit of accountability.
Personal acquisition supplies the action-to-owner relation on which liability rests.
Collateral held against a right supplies the mechanism that binds each self to what it earned.

structural_cues: The universal singular 'every self' in 74:38 breaks the earlier household plural into accountable individuals.
The later rule ties detention to earning rather than lineage, attendance, or household standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a present kin group and an individual collateral rule; I infer that the latter blocks filial presence from operating as transferable liability or release. The rule may govern a later scene without directly redefining the earlier gift.

changed_reading.before: A present filial group can look like a shared reserve of strength and security.
changed_reading.after: Their presence intensifies the eventual isolation of accountability: no density of kin dissolves the bond between each self and its own earning.

context_deltas.mechanism: An abundantly attended inner household is set against failure to feed the abased outsider; filial presence can therefore diagnose provision concentrated inside the kin boundary rather than circulated outward.

activation_trace.role: Kin belonging supplies the inner social boundary within which abundance is visibly concentrated.
The sons' continuing presence makes the populated inner household conspicuous.
Feeding another supplies the outward distributive act absent from the later confession.
The abasement of poverty supplies the excluded social recipient beyond the privileged kin circle.

structural_cues: The focus foregrounds a populated household within a sequence of abundance.
The later confession names failure to direct sustenance toward the poor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies household abundance and later non-feeding; I infer a contrast between inward kin provision and outward obligation. It does not state that this particular father fed his sons while withholding from the poor, so the distributional link remains exploratory.

changed_reading.before: Many present sons simply enlarge the household's blessing.
changed_reading.after: Their concentrated presence may expose the ethical perimeter of that blessing: a full inner circle can coexist with failure to sustain the vulnerable outside it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The joining of an advocate to another person is explicitly denied beneficial force, so knowledgeable filial witnesses lose the protective function that their attendance initially suggests.

activation_trace.role: Filiation supplies kin whose loyalty could ordinarily make them expected advocates.
Knowledgeable testimony supplies the strongest possible filial advocacy model.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the efficacy that the verse explicitly removes.
An intercessor joining another supplies the advocacy mechanism whose benefit fails.

structural_cues: 74:48 negates the benefit of intercession after the individual-accountability scene.
The focus's attendance and testimony senses make filial advocacy a plausible expectation for that negation to undo.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies filial witnesses, joined advocacy, and denied benefit; I infer a blocked protective role for the sons. A live alternative is that شُهُودًا means only resident and never raises an advocacy expectation.

changed_reading.before: Present, knowledgeable sons can look like a durable circle of social defense.
changed_reading.after: Their possible testimony cannot become saving advocacy; presence survives as visibility while its presumed protective benefit collapses.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet never says that the sons heard, repeated, or endorsed the later verdict. It remains anchored in their explicit presence and in the witnessing-tongue branch, while the later sequence supplies deliberation, measured formulation, and public saying. Render only as a possible court-audience dynamic, not as a claim that the sons transmitted the speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sons are explicitly present/witnessing, permitting a resident-audience reading without replacing their literal filiation.

activation_trace.role: Filiation supplies a close resident circle around the speaker.
Presence with witnessing supplies the sons as a possible audience to later conduct.
The witnessing tongue supplies the exploratory possibility that an attending circle can give speech social reach.
The heart's repeated deliberation supplies the private preparation of the verdict.
Calculated management supplies the shaping of the verdict before utterance.
A saying that spreads among people supplies the possible public afterlife of the calculated speech.

changed_reading.before: The sons merely attend the father as a sign of private household prosperity.
changed_reading.after: They may also form the resident audience through which his calculated judgment acquires the posture of a public, repeatable verdict.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because no number is assigned to the sons and they are never called soldiers. It remains anchored in their plural presence and the ب ن ي support image, while the later counted guardians and unknowable hosts supply a scale contrast. Render as an analogy between visible human retinue and divine forces, never as a military identification of the sons.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Present plural sons can be pictured as a visible finite retinue supporting household power.

activation_trace.role: Settled posts and supports supply the image of a human retinue holding up worldly power.
Visible presence makes the human support group inspectable and apparently countable.
Enumeration supplies the finite-count frame applied to the guardians.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the limit placed on human access to the hosts' scale.
A mutually supporting host supplies the larger force against which the household retinue is relativized.

changed_reading.before: The visible sons make the father's support network appear substantial and secure.
changed_reading.after: Their finite visibility can instead expose scale: a countable human retinue is set beneath hosts whose extent belongs to divine knowledge.

strongest_changes: Created aloneness turns present sons from proof of autonomous strength into a bestowed reversal that witnesses dependence.
The provision sequence and immediate appetite for increase recast sons as resident infrastructure and as entries in an unclosed acquisition ledger.
Individual collateral and failed intercession strip filial presence of transferable liability and saving advocacy.
summary.what_was_special: The focus crosses filiation with presence, testimony, and visible sign. Context repeatedly reverses the same attendance from a status asset into evidence of received favor, individualized exposure, and finally ineffective protection.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether شُهُودًا should activate knowledgeable testimony beyond its strong physical-presence sense.
Whether the adjacent wealth and preparation clauses intentionally make the sons functional infrastructure or merely list parallel favors.
How directly the later accountability and intercession scenes should be allowed to retroject onto the particular sons in the focus.
